cohort: 459 women with type 1 diabetes for at least 15 years
finding: Strict glycemic and blood pressure control, along with modern fetal surveillance techniques, may contribute to improved perinatal outcomes in women with long-duration type 1 diabetes, as evidenced by a decrease in preterm birth, SGA, and emergency cesarean section rates over a 25-year period.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate decreased significantly over the study period.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight increased across time periods (2850g, 3189g, 3321g, p < 0.0001)
